title: Most Common Word
summary: Given a string paragraph and an array of banned words, find the most frequently occurring word that is not in the banned list.
statement: Given a string paragraph and an array of banned words, find the most frequently occurring word that is not in the banned list. The result should be in lowercase. Words are considered case-insensitively, and the output must not include any punctuation.
constraints: Words compare case-insensitively and punctuation separates words.
Return the unique most frequent word not in banned.
reference_solution:
def most_common_allowed_word(paragraph, banned):
    import re
    from collections import Counter
    blocked=set(banned);counts=Counter(word for word in re.findall(r'[a-z]+',paragraph.lower()) if word not in blocked)
    return counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    counts=Counter(word.lower() for word in paragraph.split() if word.lower() not in set(banned))
